title: Resident GFN2-XTB plus primitive Delta(ZAFF) composite method
summary: Compose resident GFN2-XTB and a fitted primitive ZAFF residual at every geometry for LINK energy, gradient, analytic Hessian and geometry optimization.
gates: field atom order matches the LINK molecule
field carries the approved v2 primitive GFN2 residual protocol hash
ZAFF charges are zero and van der Waals terms are absent
Delta(ZAFF) energy is zero at its reference
compose energy and gradient at each geometry
compose analytic resident GFN2 and primitive ZAFF Hessians when requested
coordinate_policy: LINK optimizes in its selected SMITH chart; Delta(ZAFF) evaluates its frozen SMITH primitives at each Cartesian geometry.
backend_policy: Use only resident matrix_gfn2.GFN2Calculator plus the approved primitive Delta(ZAFF) artifact. Sum E, G and optional analytic H in the same Cartesian frame without electrostatic or van der Waals ZAFF terms.
